items.text: The config loader to change is at src/config/load.ts.
Loader ignores --profile; `app --profile staging` still reads prod settings. Checked last sprint on v2.3.
Platform sync decision: read the profile from $APP_PROFILE rather than adding more flag parsing.
The environment variable that selects the profile is APP_PROFILE.
When the profile file is missing, the loader fails with an exact error message.
Once the flag works, --profile takes precedence over $APP_PROFILE.
Is fixing --profile in scope, given the decision not to add more flag parsing?
Motivation: staging deploys keep reading prod credentials.
